title: Symrise delivered strong volume-driven organic sales growth in Q3 2026 and reaffirms full-year outlook
summary: – Sustained momentum drove organic sales growth of 5.3% in Q3 2026 (3.0% in 9M 2026) – Broad-based volume-driven growth across both segments – Progressed portfolio strategy and ONE SYM Transformation initiatives – Reaffirmed full year 2026 outlook
